oneLineChain: 5m closed -> 2/2 pivot + swing registry -> EQ (2/2 current point vs ACTIVE Dynamic-D historical anchor) -> WATCH (immediate) -> raw 3-candle FVG -> first matching FVG (ordinal 1) -> EQ/FVG semantic gate -> entry plan (bias gate -> Dynamic-D target -> sizing -> RR) -> LIMIT at FVG midpoint -> fill -> SL/TP protection

chain.role: poll new closed 5m candles and drive the engine one bar at a time
per closed 5m bar: incremental liquidity, EQ step, snapshot, displacement, AMD, FVG
confirm the 2/2 pivot at index-2, wrap it as swing liquidity, run the EQ step with the newly confirmed swings
the 2-left / 2-right local pivot test
wrap a pivot into a SWING_HIGH/SWING_LOW liquidity object with confirmedAt = confirming candle closeTime
ordinary 2/2 current point vs ACTIVE same-side Dynamic-D anchors within 432 bars and 5m-ATR14 x 0.7
historical anchor lifecycle (ACTIVE/INACTIVE), age expiry, strict-cross invalidation, localized wick extreme
build the per-bar EQ/FVG step {evaluationTime, newEqualLiquidity, newConfirmedSwings, rawFvg}
feed the step into the WATCH state machine and queue ordinal-1 notifications for the semantic gate
create one WATCH per new EQ event and count raw 3-candle FVGs against it
the production FVG definition: a raw 3-candle gap at the completed bar
semantic gate on the EQ-FVG association; sets executionAllowed
if executionAllowed, hand the enriched event to the execution service
admission, one-shot EQ consumption, slot check, entry plan, order submission
the entry plan contract: bias gate, TP target, sizing, RR geometry
4H bias gate (AVAILABLE, closedAt match, direction, STRONG, HIGH)
nearest ACTIVE opposite-side Dynamic-D historical point that price has not traded through
tick-normalised prices, quantity from target notional, RR >= MIN_INITIAL_RR
LIMIT entry; STOP_MARKET + TAKE_PROFIT_MARKET algo orders with closePosition on MARK_PRICE
only after a fill (qty > 0) are SL then TP submitted; a 5s poll plus the user data stream drive reconciliation
